title: upgrade_required
description: The app is too old for this hub: its protocol_version is missing or below min_protocol_version (reason 'protocol'), or its app_version is below min_app_version[platform] (reason 'app_version'). Answer to auth or pair; the hub closes the connection with 4426 right after. The app must not reconnect in a loop and must not reset its pairing: it shows a localized 'Please update the app' hint built from reason, and retries only after an app update or a manual retry. message is an English fallback for logs.

platform.description: Platform the app reported, null if missing or unknown.
